title: 第10章 算计与敲打
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
云州的局势，远比陆舟预想的还要凶险棘手。

    他只能暂时放下，只打算抵达云州后再从长计议。

    当务之急，唯有尽快提升自身实力，才有立足之本。

    一旁，余婉清浅浅一笑，随即侧过身，做了个请的手势：“王爷，商会上乘武技太过珍贵，可否移步雅室，婉清亲自为您展示？”

    得知对方身份后，她早就生出了交好的心思。

    此次准备的武技，便是关键！

    但此等事情，不宜招摇。

    所以她特意寻了一个单独相处的机会。

    如此一来，既能彰显商会诚意，亦能让对方留有体面。

    然而不等陆舟开口，周川却抢先一步，冷脸道：“王爷不可，此地陌生，独自前往，谁知道他们存着什么心思！”

    李雄也连忙附和，一脸警惕：“是啊王爷，有事就在这里说便是，何必单独进屋，我二人守在身边也好护您周全。”

    受了恩惠，两人对陆舟无比在意，再加上此前对方就遭遇过刺杀，生怕这次又出现意外。

    陆舟淡淡摆了摆手：“无妨，流云商会贵为茶州第一商会，若真心怀不轨，何须如此麻烦？”

    说罢，他抬眼望向余婉清，眸光透亮，意味深长：“你说是吧，余总管？”

    这话，话里有话。

    余婉清连忙放低姿态，柔声道：“王爷放心，我流云商会最重名声，就算给婉清一百个胆子，也万万不敢对您冒犯！”

    “而且雅室就在大殿内，若真有意外，您的护卫也能及时反应。”

    她需要对方这条人脉，自然不敢得罪。

    周川和李雄对视一眼，决定待会就守在门口警戒，以防万一。

    “走吧！”陆舟起身。

    他倒很好奇，这流云商会的上乘武技到底如何。

    余婉清立即引路，走向殿右廊尽头的内室。

    房间雅致静谧，沉香萦绕，隔绝了外面所有声响，私密性极好。

    “王爷，您请坐！”余婉清温婉浅笑，俯身为其亲自斟上一杯上好热茶。

    陆舟抬眼，恰好撞见那一抹细腻如雪的肌肤，眼角微抽。

    好有实力！

    余婉清瞧见这一幕，笑而不语，转身从书柜中拉开暗格，取出了三本武技。

    “王爷，这三本乃是商会最好的武技，您且看看。”她将其依次放在了桌上，恭立一旁。

    和功法不同，武技的侧重点在于搏杀对敌。

    核心便是把自身力量转化为攻击、防御和身法招式。

    依靠各种招式、套路等战斗技巧来提升自己的战斗力。

    其本身与境界挂钩，同样分为一到九品，以及神级武技。

    历来武技皆与自身境界相辅相成，武者大多会修习同品阶武技，修行起来事半功倍。

    除此之外，武技挑选亦要看自身所长。

    譬如周川擅使长枪，所修武技便皆以枪法为主，贴合自身路数。

    只是茶州地域底蕴有限，纵然是流云商会，真正拿得出手的顶尖武技也寥寥无几。
content_en:
The situation in Yunzhou is far more dangerous and difficult than Lu Zhou expected.

    He could only put it down for the time being, and only planned to make long-term plans after arriving in Yunzhou.

    The most urgent task is to improve one's own strength as soon as possible in order to gain a foothold.

    On the side, Yu Wanqing smiled lightly, then turned sideways and made a gesture of invitation: "Your Majesty, the martial arts skills of the Chamber of Commerce are too precious. Can you move to the private room and Wanqing show it to you personally?"

    After learning the identity of the other party, she had long been interested in making friends with him.

    The martial arts skills prepared this time are the key!

    But such things should not be ostentatious.

    So she deliberately looked for an opportunity to be alone.

    In this way, it can not only show the sincerity of the chamber of commerce, but also allow the other party to retain dignity.

    However, before Lu Zhou could speak, Zhou Chuan took the lead and said with a cold face: "My lord, no, this is a strange place. If you go alone, who knows what they have in mind!"

    Li Xiong also quickly agreed, with a vigilant look on his face: "Yes, Your Majesty, if you have anything to do, just say it here. Why go into the house alone? I and I can stay by your side to protect you."

    After receiving the favor, the two of them cared deeply about Lu Zhou. In addition, the other party had been assassinated before, so they were afraid that something unexpected would happen again this time.

    Lu Zhou waved his hand calmly: "It doesn't matter, Liuyun Chamber of Commerce is the number one chamber of commerce in Tea State. If you really have evil intentions, why bother?"

    After saying that, he raised his eyes to look at Yu Wanqing, his eyes bright and meaningful: "You think so, Manager Yu?"

    There is something in these words.

    Yu Wanqing quickly lowered her posture and said softly: "Prince, don't worry, our reputation is the most important in Liuyun Chamber of Commerce. Even if we give Wanqing a hundred courages, we will never dare to offend you!"

    "And the private room is in the main hall. If there is an accident, your guards will be able to respond in time."

    She needs the other party's connections, so naturally she doesn't dare to offend him.

    Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong looked at each other and decided to stand guard at the door later, just in case.

    "Let's go!" Lu Zhou stood up.

    He was curious about the superior martial arts skills of Liuyun Chamber of Commerce.

    Yu Wanqing immediately led the way to the inner room at the end of the right corridor of the palace.

    The room is elegant and quiet, with aloes lingering, blocking out all sounds from outside, and providing excellent privacy.

    "Your Majesty, please take a seat!" Yu Wanqing smiled gently and leaned over to personally pour a cup of hot tea for him.

    Lu Zhou raised his eyes and happened to catch sight of that delicate, snow-like skin, and the corners of his eyes twitched slightly.

    So powerful!

    When Yu Wanqing saw this scene, she smiled and said nothing. She turned around and opened the secret compartment in the bookcase and took out three books on martial arts.

    "Your Majesty, these three books are the best martial arts in the Chamber of Commerce. Take a look." She placed them on the table one by one and stood aside respectfully.

    Unlike Kung Fu, martial arts focus on fighting the enemy.

    The core is to transform one's own power into attack, defense and body movements.

    Rely on various moves, routines and other combat skills to improve your combat effectiveness.

    It itself is linked to the realm, and is also divided into grades one to nine, as well as god-level martial arts.

    Historically, martial arts have been complementary to one's own realm. Most martial artists will practice martial arts of the same level, so they can get twice the result with half the effort.

    In addition, the choice of martial arts also depends on one's own strengths.

    For example, Zhou Chuan is good at using spears, and all his martial arts skills focus on marksmanship, which suits his own style.

    It's just that Chazhou's geographical background is limited, and even the Liuyun Chamber of Commerce has very few truly top-notch martial arts skills.
